More Information about Suspension -
A car's suspension is also responsible for the stable handling of a vehicle. In fact, without a suspension system, it may be impossible to drive a car. The front-end clunking noise you hear when driving over a road bump means that a part of the suspension is faulty or malfunctioning.
The rubber can separate from the metal components and cause noise. Also, the bearings can fail and cause memory steer, rough spots and noise. Most upper strut mounts have a thin layer of rubber between the mount and strut tower. The relentless pounding from the suspension can degrade the rubber.

The Four Sounds of Suspension Problems

There are four sounds in particular that you should look out for: creaking, grunting, rattling, and knocking.

Signs Your Suspension Is Bad
The Steering Wheel Feels Shaky. When driving, the steering wheel should be steady. ...
Excess Tire Wear. There can be many reasons your tires are worn, but one could be a faulty suspension system. ...
Leaking Around Shocks and Struts. ...
An Uncomfortable Ride. ...
Car Bounces After a Speed Bump. ...
Clunking Sounds.

Suspension is the system of tires, tire air, springs, shock absorbers and linkages that connect a vehicle to its wheels and allow relative motion between the two. Suspension systems must support both road holding/handling and ride quality, which are at odds with each other.
A car suspension includes a variety of essential components that work together to ensure smooth and safe drivability. The basic building blocks of a car suspension system are springs (coil springs, air springs, leaf springs or torsion bars) and dampers (shock absorbers, struts, and anti-sway bars).

More Information about suspension noise problem - 

A Maruti Suzuki Ertiga may make suspension noise when driving over bumps. Some possible causes include: 
Worn tie-rod ends or ball joints
Weak suspension system
Rapid expansion of the suspension mechanism spring
Here are some other suspension problems that may occur: 
Clattering rattle from the front suspension
Excessive vibration in the steering column
Clunking noise while driving
Other common problems with the Maruti Suzuki Ertiga include: 
High level of noise from the diesel engine
Noisy engine in the petrol model.
